# 0.14.2 — 14 October 2026

Patch on 0.14.1. Nothing to do after upgrading and nothing to regenerate, but upgrade promptly if you or your agents run `opentide setup skills`: it could be made to install skill content from a repository other than the pinned catalogue.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.14.2
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Fixed

- **`opentide setup skills` can no longer be steered outside the pinned catalogue.** The installer pins its source to `OpenTideHQ/skills`, but it interpolated the catalogue manifest's `ref`, the skill `slug` and each tree path into `raw.githubusercontent.com` and `api.github.com` URLs without rejecting `..`. GitHub normalises dot segments server-side, so a manifest ref of `../../../attacker/payload/main` resolved to a **different public repository**, whose `SKILL.md` files were then installed into `.agents/skills/` — unreviewed agent instructions on a developer or agent machine, delivered by the tool whose promise is that the catalogue is pinned. The write side had the same gap: a tree entry such as `skills/<slug>/../../.git/hooks/pre-commit` escaped the staging directory, turning a catalogue listing into an arbitrary file write.

  Containment is now enforced at four points — the ref, the slug, each repository path, and the fully-assembled URL after dot-segment removal, with scheme, host, path prefix and query re-verified and embedded credentials or a fragment refused — and every written file is confirmed to resolve inside the skill tree. A rejected manifest ref falls back to `main` instead of being used; a rejected slug or path aborts the install rather than writing a partial tree ([#483](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/483)).

## Changed

- Runtime dependencies moved up with no API, schema or output change: `pydantic` 2.13.5 → 2.14.0, `orjson` 3.12.0 → 3.13.0, `dulwich` 1.2.15 → 1.2.17, `typer` 0.27.2 → 0.27.3 ([#502](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/502), [#500](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/500), [#501](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/501), [#498](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/pull/498)).

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.14.2
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.14.2
opentide --version
```
